top_signals.title: Bank of England set to defy Fed’s rate-hike lead, despite rising inflation
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England is expected to keep rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs keep pressure on prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
